name: Almwirtschaft Berwang
kurzbeschreibung: Cozy mountain inn in **Berwang** offering regional cheese specialties, homemade smoked bacon, and stunning panoramic views.
beschreibung: The Almwirtschaft Berwang in Berwang is a charming alpine hut nestled in the breathtaking Tyrolean mountain landscape, offering pure, authentic alpine romance. Here, hikers and day-trippers enjoy a well-deserved break with stunning views of the surrounding peaks. The menu features hearty alpine specialties like homemade Kaiserschmarrn, spiced Almkäse with bread, and refreshing Buttermilch—all prepared with products from the farm itself. The simple yet refined cuisine is the perfect reward after a hike. The sunny terrace invites you to linger, while the rustic interior provides warmth and coziness on cooler days. The Almwirtschaft Berwang is a slice of Tyrolean alpine culture you simply must experience.
